title: sec filing / 8 k / corporate governance | Regulatory Guidance | Greenpro Capital Corp. Form 8-K — Departure of Director
summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 disclosing the resignation of Christopher Yu Nien Wong from its Board of Directors, effective April 30, 2026, along with his departure from the Audit, Compensation, and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees. The filing states the resignation was not the result of any disagreement with the company. The company is evaluating candidates to fill the vacancy.
